# Doubo (都播)

> {{ en.meta.description }}

Doubo is a native IPTV / M3U playlist player, available for iPhone, iPad, and Mac (SwiftUI and AVKit), with Android phones, tablets, and Android TV / TV boxes coming soon. It plays M3U / M3U8 playlists that users add themselves (by URL or file); it does not bundle or sell any channels. Highlights: grouped channel browsing, search and favorites, parallel channel checks, switching between multiple sources of the same channel, Picture in Picture, subtitle tracks, playback speed, DLNA casting to smart TVs, local video playback, and on-device storage with no ads or analytics SDKs. Apple TV and CarPlay versions are planned.

## Pages
- [Home]({{ '/en/' | absolute_url }}): features, platforms, roadmap summary, FAQ
- [Guide]({{ '/en/guide/' | absolute_url }}): how to add and play M3U / M3U8 playlists
- [Online M3U player]({{ '/en/web/' | absolute_url }}): free web player with live previews of free channels; plays your own M3U links in the browser
- [M3U analyzer & cleaner]({{ '/en/tools/m3u/' | absolute_url }}): count channels and groups, remove duplicate links, sort and export a playlist, in the browser
- Device guides: how to play M3U playlists on {% for d in site.guide_devices %}[{{ site.data.guides.en.devices[d.key].name }}]({{ '/en/guide/' | append: d.key | append: '/' | absolute_url }}){% unless forloop.last %}, {% endunless %}{% endfor %}
- Channel pages: one page per free channel at {{ '/en/channels/' | absolute_url }}<channel-id>/ with country, category, language, owner, launch year, official website and a live web player link; country pages at {{ '/en/playlists/' | absolute_url }}<country-code>/ and category pages at {{ '/en/playlists/category/' | absolute_url }}<category>/
- [Free channel directory]({{ '/en/playlists/' | absolute_url }}): free-to-air channels that broadcasters publish openly, as M3U playlists by country, category and language (source and policy: https://github.com/streamline-iptv/iptv-playlists)
- [Roadmap]({{ '/en/roadmap/' | absolute_url }}): shipped, in-progress, and planned features
- [Support]({{ '/en/support/' | absolute_url }}): FAQ and contact
- [Privacy Policy]({{ '/en/privacy/' | absolute_url }})
